title: We gained information...
text: We gained information about the general area & it’s rich history plus lots of facts about buildings & architecture that we would have simply just walked passed & missed.
author: Kim_W

title: Beautiful Walk
text: This tour is not for the faint of heart (lots of uphill and downhill walking) but it was well worth the huffing and puffing. Our tour guides (we cannot remember their names, unfortunately) were fabulous and they were willing to stop for those in our group who were older to give them more time; fine by me, more photo time! We learned so much about the city's history and architecture, and walked to places I never would have thought to myself. I'd recommend this tour on a day you aren't going to the Alhambra as it's a lot of walking, but a great option for other days in town!
author: JesL856

title: A really great way to get an appreciation of the local areas
text:
I recently booked us on a walking tour in Granada, through Albayzin and Sacromonte. and it was one of the highlights of my trip to Spain! The guide was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and clearly passionate about the city’s rich history and culture. We explored charming neighborhoods, climbed lots of steps (beware if you dont like climbing), and enjoyed exploring the narrow, winding streets and stunning views of the Alhambra, and learned so much about Granada’s fascinating blend of Moorish and Spanish influences.

title: Highly recommended visit
text: Visit for framing and a very charming tour. We have been to Granada several times and wanted to get to know these two neighborhoods well, we really liked passing through streets that we had never seen. The guide, Cristina, great. We thought being a two and a half hour visit we were going to get tired, but not at all. Situating on historical dates and events, linking with anecdotes and curiosities has been able to keep our attention throughout the tour. In a formal and fun tone at the same time, you can see the work and effort behind it. It has been one of our best guided views we have ever don
author: Tite26
